biggest_catch: The reward is a renewal credit on your own Mint Mobile plan — not cash — and it only works if your friend activates a new line and pays for three months upfront. You're capped at four referrals ($360) per year.
catches: Your credit is $45/$60/$75/$90 depending on which plan your friend buys — not a flat $90.
Credit applies only to your Mint Mobile renewal; it can't be withdrawn as cash.
Capped at four referrals ($360 max credit) per year.
Your friend must activate a new line and pay for a three-month plan upfront.
Your friend gets a $15 credit — the reward is smaller on their side.

steps: Sign in to your Mint Mobile account and get your personal referral link.
Share the link with friends who are not already Mint customers.
Your friend activates a new Mint line and pays for a three-month plan upfront.
You receive a $45/$60/$75/$90 renewal credit based on their plan; they get a $15 credit.
Repeat with up to four friends per year (max $360 in credits).
timing: Renewal credit posted after your friend's qualifying activation and three-month prepayment.
